args.task_description: 实现 gui-only-one-click-update 功能：Add a one-click GUI-only update path to the existing Electron Coding Tools desktop app. Download a trusted checksum-verified renderer build, apply it, and reload only the renderer window. Keep MCP, Codex Bridge, and Proxy Bridge running with no stop, restart, route restore, or whole-app installer. Support release packaging. Preserve unrelated dirty edits. Verify focused tests and rendered UI.

globalRules: 首次执行计划时调用 plan_heartbeat 并附完整 plan，建立本地检查点
每完成、跳过或阻塞一个步骤后调用 plan_heartbeat 更新证据与状态
会话中断或切换 Agent 后先调用 resume_plan，再继续未完成步骤
只有 converge 返回 passed=true 后，才能将本次结论正式写入长期记忆
Agent 必须按步骤顺序调用 MCP，并使用宿主能力完成真实文件与代码操作

历史记忆仅作为参考，当前项目事实与代码优先
